messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for enterprise tenant 'Vanguard' (tenant_id: tid-0421) in eu-central-1 dedicated pool. p99 jumped to 2.6s (baseline 350ms). Error rate stable. Alert rule: dedicated_pool.p99 > 1.5s for 2m. Paging oncall.
Priya S (oncall): ACK. I'm on it. Priya -> Alex/Marco/Josh for engineering triage.
Alex M (SRE): looking at infra now — GPUs in pool show high kernel latency on node set dpool-euc-11. Network metrics OK. Rolling p95->p99 diff indicates long tail on large-context requests. Pulling slowest traces.
Josh R (runtime): thanks. Two quick mitigation options: 1) shift traffic off dpool-euc-11 to spare nodes, 2) route heavy requests to smaller model variant (quantized) for non-critical routes. Prefer routing change + temporary per-tenant rate cap.
Marco D (prod-eng): agree with Josh. We have spare dedicated capacity in eu-central (dpool-euc-13 warm). Can do weight shift + tenant isolation. Will coordinate control-plane commands.
Lena C (CSE): prepping customer-facing note. Vanguard is actively seeing increased latency on heavy batch scoring. I'll draft a short status for them once we have mitigation plan.
Alex M (SRE): quick check: disk I/O on dpool-euc-11 is fine. GPU SM utilization high and one node shows sporadic ECC warnings earlier today but cleared. Might be thermal throttling pattern. We'll avoid draining all nodes at once.
Priya S (oncall): action plan: (A) shift 40% of Vanguard's traffic to dpool-euc-13 (warm spare) (B) apply tenant-level soft rate limit to 60rps for non-peak endpoints /v1/generate-bulk (C) route non-interactive requests to model variant redwood/gpt-small-q4. I'll execute A,B now. Marco, Josh coordinate variant routing.
Josh R (runtime): executing variant route. Command to adjust routing weights (control-plane API):
```bash
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.example/api/v1/routing/adjust \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tid-0421","from_pool":"dpool-euc-11","to_pool":"dpool-euc-13","weight":0.4}'
```
Applying canary in 30s.
Marco D (prod-eng): I'll run tenant isolation job to move Vanguard's heavy routes into a dedicated routing slot so other tenants unaffected. command:
```json
{"action":"isolate_tenant","tenant_id":"tid-0421","pool":"dpool-euc-13","timeout":600}
```
Kickoff in 45s.
ops-bot: autoscaler: detected spare capacity in dpool-euc-13; provisioning 2 nodes (expected ready in ~90s).
Alex M (SRE): starting incremental drain of the busiest pods on dpool-euc-11 -> don’t drain more than 1 node at a time. Monitoring tail latency.
Priya S (oncall): applied soft rate limit on /v1/generate-bulk: 60rps (soft). Added header X-Redwood-Rate-Limit-Note for visibility.
Lena C (CSE): draft for Vanguard: "We're aware of elevated p99 latency for some heavy workloads in eu-central. We've routed a portion of your traffic to warm capacity and applied temporary rate controls to reduce tail latency. No data loss; we'll update in 15m." Want me to send now?
Priya S (oncall): wait 5m to confirm trend.
Josh R (runtime): canary routing in place — first 10% traffic shows p99 down to 900ms. Push to 40% now.
Marco D (prod-eng): tenant isolation job started. pipeline logs: "isolation:slot-assigned -> migrating routes -> success for slot vanguard-iso-3"
Alex M (SRE): after shifting 40%, cluster p99 for Vanguard dropped to 480ms. Node dpool-euc-11 still shows 1 noisy GPU; I'll mark it for maintenance after we stabilize.
ops-bot: node-provisioner: dpool-euc-13 nodes ready.
Priya S (oncall): trending good. Initiate customer update now. Lena, send.
Lena C (CSE): sent to Vanguard contact (account@vanguard.example): "We've mitigated the latency spike by shifting traffic to warm capacity and applying temporary controls. We're continuing to monitor; targeted follow-up in 30m. Contact CSE rep for questions"
Priya S (oncall): handoff note for next oncall: incident remains monitored; mitigation in place (40% weight shift, tenant isolation, soft rate limit 60rps on bulk endpoint). Marking P1 -> P2 watch. Please escalate if p99 > 1s for 5m.
Marco D (prod-eng): created follow-up ticket: ENG-5642 to investigate GPU thermal throttling on dpool-euc-11 and add automation to avoid noisy single-node behavior.
Josh R (runtime): we'll keep model-variant fallback enabled for bulk routes for the next 2 hours, then re-evaluate.
Alex M (SRE): scheduling maintenance window for dpool-euc-11 tonight to replace GPU node.
Priya S (oncall): closing active paging. Monitoring only. Thanks team. :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: paging cleared for tid-0421. Current p99 480ms. Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.
Priya S (oncall): final note: postmortem owner Marco D. Runbook edits: add automated weight-shift play for dedicated-pool p99 spikes; customer comms template updated.
Lena C (CSE): I'll follow up with Vanguard tomorrow with technical summary.
Marco D (prod-eng): noted. Moving to postmortem tasks.
ops-bot: closing temporary rate-limit rule after 2h unless re-opened"
